description:
SessionManager silently ignores Entry.Label entries in the JSONL file. The label maps are
never built, so labels set in previous sessions are lost on reload. Add the label index and
the read/write API.

## Gaps

### Struct (session_manager.ex lines 36-46)
Missing two fields:
  labels_by_id: %{},           # target_id => label string
  label_timestamps_by_id: %{}  # target_id => ISO-8601 timestamp

### index/1 (lines 610-617)
Currently: just maps id => entry for every body entry, ignores entry type.
Required: when entry is %Entry.Label{}, also update the label maps:
  - entry.label non-nil  → put(labels_by_id, entry.target_id, entry.label)
                           put(label_timestamps_by_id, entry.target_id, entry.timestamp)
  - entry.label nil      → delete(labels_by_id, entry.target_id)
                           delete(label_timestamps_by_id, entry.target_id)

Mirrors upstream _buildIndex() lines 756-769 in session-manager.ts.

### get_label/2 (new)
```elixir
@spec get_label(t(), String.t()) :: String.t() | nil
def get_label(%__MODULE__{labels_by_id: m}, id), do: Map.get(m, id)
```
Mirrors getLabel() line 997 in session-manager.ts.

### append_label_change/3 (new)
```elixir
@spec append_label_change(t(), String.t(), String.t() | nil) :: {t(), Entry.Label.t()}
def append_label_change(%__MODULE__{} = sm, target_id, label)
```
- Raise if target_id not in by_id (mirrors upstream throw)
- Build %Entry.Label{target_id: target_id, label: label} and call add_entry/2
- Update labels_by_id / label_timestamps_by_id based on label nil-ness
- Return {updated_sm, materialized_entry}

Mirrors appendLabelChange() lines 1006-1031 in session-manager.ts.

Note: add_entry/2 already sets :id, :parent_id, :timestamp and updates by_id + leaf_id.
append_label_change/3 only needs to additionally maintain the label maps.

apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/session_manager.ex

Port tests from tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/session-manager/labels.test.ts.
Cover: label set, label update, label clear (nil), reload from file preserves labels,
label on unknown id raises.

## Verification
Load a session file that contains Entry.Label entries; confirm get_label/2 returns the
resolved value. append_label_change/3 round-trip: set a label, reload the file, confirm
the label is still present.
